sources.name: OpenMMS real-world injection-mould monitoring raw case study
sources.faultProtocol: Repeated simulated extraction-pin fault by tightening a screw against the force-sensor ejector pin after the initial normal run.
sources.value: Exceptionally relevant raw family for normal-to-fault progression, ejection-force diagnostics, mould monitoring and maintenance-learning cases.
sources.nextAction: Profile exact CSV row count, columns, units, missingness, time base and cycle segmentation from the pinned blob; retain raw file outside repository if required and store only fingerprints/aggregate profile.

sources.name: SINTEF/NTNU injection-moulding API multi-rate raw sensor supplements
sources.reportedPlatform: ENGEL controllers CC300/RC300 plus RevPi third-party sensor DAQ
sources.value: Useful raw family for multi-rate sampling, machine-vs-external-sensor synchronization, timestamp semantics and actual-vs-machine data acquisition validation.
sources.limitations: The published tests are principally API/synchronization validation; at least one 2 Hz supplement notes pressure_mold is zero because the IMM is off, so physical-process-value selection must be supplement-specific.
sources.nextAction: Retrieve each publisher supplement separately, fingerprint, inspect whether the machine is operating, and count only directly measured physical channels with established units/time base.

sources.name: 2025 industrial plastic-injection machine state/fault corpus
sources.labeling: Raw dataset has failure events but not explicit failure type; inferred operational clusters/states were reviewed/validated with the industrial data provider/company experts.
sources.reportedModelResult: XGBoost classification accuracy 83.26% after cluster-label filtering in the published methodology.
sources.dataAvailability: Not readily available; belongs to industry and is available only under contract. Authors accessed it under maintenance and research contract.
sources.value: Very high-value acquisition target for long-duration real machine-state, human-error and maintenance/anomaly validation if owner-authorized access can be negotiated.
sources.nextAction: Request a controlled aggregate-profiling or owner-side-execution path; do not infer permission from the CC BY article.
